description: Run a condition over this project's recent visits: how many it matches, grammar problems, overlap with existing questions, and what matched visitors did. Repeat until there are no problems.

seconds.description: idle: seconds of pause · wait: seconds to wait, 60–1800 (default 300)

type.description: on_match = as soon as the steps are met · idle = after that, N seconds with no click, typing or page change (scrolling still counts as a pause) · leave = when they leave that screen: moving to another page, closing the tab on a computer, or coming back from another tab (phones cannot tell a tab closing) · wait = N seconds after the last step, if the absent step did not come in that time (the visitor may change pages meanwhile)

page.description: Path glob of the screen the visitor is on when the question appears. "*" when the condition is built from event steps

steps.description: What happened, in order. Other actions may happen in between

absent.description: This did NOT happen between the previous step and the moment the question appears

atLeast.description: Happened at least this many times

from.description: arrive/back only: path glob of the screen they came from

page.description: Path glob of the screen this happened on. * = anything, :name = one segment. Leave it out on event steps

percent.description: scroll: reached at least this % of the page

seconds.description: idle: a pause of at least this many seconds between two actions

target.description: click/input/submit: words in the element's text or field name, or class:name, or tag:BUTTON · event: the exact name the site sends with Usercase.track(name)

name: question_check
